name: A Long Road
guide: The hardest trophy. The checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and everything finished before that already counts. Full clears are required only for some rows: all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans), the 33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks. The rest is partial — 100 optional tasks, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans, 30 of 40 races, 15 of 18 card sets, 5 of 7 Kenton sets. Nothing on it is missable. (GTABase, gamemapa summarizing PowerPyx)
steps: Hardest trophy; the 100% checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; earlier work already counts.

Fully required: all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans), underwater discoveries (33), shooting range golds (42), all drone time trials (42), Bret's Target Decks (15).

Partial: 100 optional tasks, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans, 30 of 40 races, 15 of 18 card sets, 5 of 7 Kenton sets, 30 of 34 magazines.
Nothing is missable for the checklist per PowerPyx and GTABase; gamemapa notes Stick Ups need 50 of 91 and Smash 'N' Grabs 34 of 35.

Recommended order after the credits: clear full-clear robberies first (narcotics/marked-bill fencing totals come along), then Kenton + underwater discoveries, Bret's decks, ranges and drone trials, scans in passing, challenges and stunts last.

name: Cunning Stunts
guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to chain; the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Track it in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and push on to 300 since the 100% checklist wants that. (GTABase, gta.guide)
steps: Any mix counts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest; the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed.
Track in Progress > Activities > Stunts; 100% wants 300.

name: Master of None
description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning any race and doing a stunt. Progress > Activities shows what is missing; most players tick these without trying. (GTABase, gta.guide)
steps: Nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), arcade game, a race win, a stunt.
Track in Progress > Activities.

name: The Shootist
description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: Gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. Buy the $5 Waiver Pass from the clerk before using a range (easy to forget). Ranges also raise your Focus level, which sets up Gunslinger. (GTABase, gamemapa)
steps: Gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 across 12 ranges.
Buy the $5 Waiver Pass from the clerk before using a range (gamemapa).
Ranges raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger.

name: Top Fun
description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
count: 1 win at each of 14 locations (42 races total for 100%)
guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough here. Since 100% needs all 42 races anyway, clear all three courses per location while you're there; per gamemapa you must beat par on the first two courses, the third only needs a finish. (GTABase, gamemapa)
steps: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of 14 locations.
100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish every course per location.
gamemapa: 3 courses per location; beat par on the first two, the third only needs a finish.

name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available; re-winning the same race does not count. For 100% you need 30 unique wins, so line up the easiest 20 first and the rest follow. (GTABase, gamemapa)
steps: 20 different races must be won; re-winning the same race does not count.
100% needs 30 of 40 unique race wins, so pick the easiest 20.
